# Pacific Northwest Audiology

> > Pacific Northwest Audiology provides comprehensive hearing aid services, audiological evaluations, and expert fittings across Bend and Redmond, Oregon.

Pacific Northwest Audiology is a full-service audiology practice with experienced audiologists including Dr. Taylor Garagiola, Dr. Jamie Hubbard-Parker, and Jason Johnson. They offer hearing aids from leading brands like Phonak, Widex, Oticon, ReSound, Signia, and Starkey, along with hearing evaluations, repair services, and educational resources on hearing loss and tinnitus management.
